items.question: Which tasks count as open for the digest?
items.ticket: Digest is skipped when nothing is open
items.chose: Includes only tasks whose status is exactly "open" and drops all others.
items.instead: Treat other in-progress statuses (for example under review) as open too.

items.question: What does buildDigest return when nothing is open?
items.ticket: Digest is skipped when nothing is open
items.instead: Return a digest with an empty task list, or throw.

items.question: Is a task stalled when its last activity is exactly 14 days ago?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Flags it as stalled when the gap is 14 days or more, using a >= comparison on milliseconds.
items.instead: Flag only when the gap is more than 14 days (strict >).

items.question: How is the 14-day clock measured for a task that has never had a submission?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Measures from the posting time when there are no submissions.
items.instead: Never flag a task without submissions, or count it as stalled right away.

items.question: Is the stall clock measured from the latest submission, or from any submission within the window?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Measures from the most recent submission time, whatever its gate.
items.instead: Measure from the submission at the furthest gate, or from the first submission.

items.question: How is the age in days computed and rounded?
items.ticket: listing each open task with its age
items.chose: Takes whole elapsed days since posting, rounded down and clamped to at least 0.
items.instead: Round to the nearest day or round up, and allow negative ages or throw for future-dated tasks.

items.question: What is the furthest gate for a task with no submissions?
items.instead: Report null or undefined, or a label such as "none".

items.question: How is the furthest gate computed across submissions?
items.chose: Takes the highest gate number over all submissions, whatever their order or recency.
items.instead: Take the gate of the latest submission.

items.question: In what order are tasks listed in the digest?
items.chose: Sorts stalled tasks first, then by oldest postedAt, then by id ascending.
items.instead: Keep the input order, or sort by age or by id only.

items.question: What is the email subject line, and how does it handle pluralisation?
items.chose: Builds "Weekly digest: N open tasks, M stalled" and always uses the plural, even for 1 task.
items.instead: Use a fixed subject, or pluralise correctly ("1 open task").

items.question: Which day counts as Monday, and in which time zone is it judged?
items.chose: Formats the instant as a long weekday name in the given time zone and compares it to "Monday" in en-US.
items.instead: Use the UTC day, or the server's local day.

items.question: Does buildDigest validate the time zone even when the result does not depend on it?
items.chose: Validates the time zone first, so an unknown zone throws even when no tasks are open.
items.instead: Ignore the time zone in buildDigest, or validate it only after the empty check.
